title: Crab Derby, 2019 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The Saturday after: the real crab on the wall among thirty-four cartoons, and Wood at the wall a long time, and the girl coming to stand beside him and looking at the row too, and asking which one's his favorite. He points at 1998. She says that one's wrong. He says that's why.

panels.composition: The wall: thirty-five flyers, the newest a shaded real crab. WOOD before it. The GIRL coming to stand beside him. The PUP.
